title: 第290章 金丹大成第289章 后顾之忧
content_zh:
王建新从旋转餐厅出来，没有坐车，也没有跟任何人打招呼。他走到了大楼的天台上，四下看了看，确认没人，身形一晃，人就不见了。
下一瞬间，他出现在了总部大楼的楼顶上。风很大，吹得他的衣角猎猎作响。他抬头看了看天，夕阳已经沉下去了，他右手一翻，从空间里取出那把飞剑。这把剑他早就人剑合一了。
他踩上飞剑，嗖的一下就蹿了出去。
先是在京城上空转了一圈。从高处往下看，京城的夜晚灯火点点，长安街像一条金色的带子，从西直门一直铺到建国门。王建新看了几眼，心里头说不上是什么滋味。这座城，他从一个小知青熬到了副国级，这里头有他的家、他的兄弟、他的事业，还有他的命。
他没有多停留，驾驭着飞剑往北去了。
长城。从空中看下去，长城像一条巨龙，蜿蜒在崇山峻岭之间。烽火台一座连着一座，在月色下显得苍凉而壮阔。王建新放慢了速度，贴着长城飞了一段。他想起了当年在内蒙边防巡逻的日子，那时候骑着马，在边境线上来回跑，风沙打在脸上生疼。现在好了，踩着剑，想去哪就去哪。
从长城往西，飞过了太行山，飞过了黄土高原。脚下是千沟万壑的黄土地，一道道梁、一面面坡，在月光下像老人脸上的皱纹。黄河在峡谷里拐着弯，浑黄的河水闪着微弱的光。王建新沿着黄河飞了一会儿，一直飞到壶口瀑布。瀑布的声音很大，即使在半空中也听得清清楚楚，轰隆隆的，像是大地在咆哮。
他又往南飞，过了秦岭，到了巴山蜀水。四川盆地的夜里雾蒙蒙的，看不清楚地面，但能感觉到那种潮湿闷热的气息。再往东，是长江中下游平原。江面上有船，星星点点的灯火，缓缓移动着。王建新在长江上空飞了好一阵，从武汉一直飞到南京。长江大桥的灯光在夜色中格外醒目，那是咱们自己建的大桥，当年建成的时候，全国都沸腾了。
他最后又飞到了东北，在大兴安岭上空转了一圈。林海茫茫，望不到边。冬天的雪还没化尽，山头上白花花的一片。他想起了当年在草原上的日子，想起了苏和老师傅，想起了那些羊群，想起了边境线上那一场场惊心动魄的交锋。
转了一大圈，王建新终于收住了心。这片土地，经历了太多的苦难，但它还在，而且还在一步一步地往上走。他这一辈子，算是跟这片土地绑在一起了，分不开了。
他调整方向，一路向东，飞进了大海。
海面上黑漆漆的，只有月亮在水面上铺出一条银白色的路。王建新飞了很远，远到看不见大陆的轮廓了，才在一片群岛中找到了一个无人小岛。
岛不小，方圆十多里地，长着些低矮的灌木和树木。岛上没有人的痕迹，连条小路都没有。沙滩是白色的，被海浪冲刷得干干净净。王建新落在岛的最高处，一块平坦的岩石上。海风从四面八方吹过来，带着咸腥味。
他盘膝坐下，闭上眼睛，花了很长时间来调整心态。
这几个月，他的心里一直不平静。放不下家里，放不下女儿，放不下那些还没办完的事。但此刻，坐在这荒无人烟的小岛上，面对着一望无际的大海，他的心里反而安静下来了。
该交代的都交代了，该安排的都安排了。家里有老首长、有杨伟大哥、有石军长他们罩着，国家有大领导的承诺，公司有大哥二哥盯着，局里有霍副主任和老秦他们撑着。他没有什么放不下的了。
他从空间里取出了那颗丹药，他把丹药放进嘴里，咽了下去。
丹药入腹的瞬间，一股磅礴的药力爆炸开来，像一团火，从丹田烧遍全身。王建新稳坐不动，双手掐诀，引导着药力和体内的灵力融合。丹田里的液态灵力开始疯狂旋转，形成了一个巨大的漩涡，吞噬着周围一切的灵气。
小岛周围的气象开始变了。
先是海面上的风突然停了，一丝风都没有，海水平滑得像一面镜子。然后天空中聚起了云，不是普通的云，是那种带着金光的云，从四面八方涌来，越积越厚，越压越低。云层中隐隐有雷声滚动，不是打雷的那种声音，是一种更深沉的、从骨头缝里往外钻的轰鸣。

王建新不知道坐了多久。可能是几天，也可能是几十天。他的意识时而清醒时而模糊，体内的灵力已经不受他控制了，自顾自地运转着、压缩着、凝聚着。
终于有一天——
天地突变。
一道霞光从云层中射下来，正好照在王建新身上。那道光是七彩的，从没见过那种颜色，像是把彩虹揉碎了又重新拼起来。紧接着，天空中开始飘落灵雨。雨水不是从云里掉下来的，是从虚空中凭空生出来的，晶莹剔透，带着浓郁的灵气。
更奇的是海里的动静。
岛周围的海面上，突然冒出了无数的鱼。大大小小的，各种各样的，从深水里浮上来，头朝着岛的方向，整整齐齐地排列着。远处有海鸟飞来，黑压压的一片，落在岛的礁石上、灌木上，也是朝着王建新的方向，一动不动。岛上的老鼠、蜥蜴、昆虫，全从藏身的地方跑了出来，伏在地上，瑟瑟发抖。
不是朝拜，是害怕。那种来自血脉深处的、对更高层次生命的畏惧。王建新身上散发出来的威压，已经不是一个人类该有的了。
天空中，劫云凝聚成形。
六九雷劫，五十四道天雷。
第一道雷劈下来的时候，王建新连眼皮都没抬一下。那雷粗得像水桶，带着毁天灭地的气势，轰在他身上，却像泥牛入海，消失得无影无踪。他的身体现在已经是半仙之体了，这种程度的雷劫，扛得住。
content_en:
Wang Jianxin came out of the revolving restaurant without getting into a car or saying hello to anyone. He walked to the rooftop of the building, looked around to make sure there was no one there, and with a flash of his body, the person disappeared.
The next moment, he appeared on the roof of the headquarters building. The wind was strong, making the corners of his clothes rustle. He looked up at the sky and saw that the sun was setting. He flipped his right hand and took out the flying sword from the space. He had already merged this sword into one.
He stepped on the flying sword and jumped out with a swish.
First, it circled around the capital. Looking down from a high place, the capital city is brightly lit at night, and Chang'an Street is like a golden belt, stretching from Xizhimen to Jianguomen. Wang Jianxin took a few glances and couldn't tell what he felt. In this city, he rose from a young educated youth to the deputy state level. This city contained his family, his brothers, his career, and his life.
He didn't stay long and drove the flying sword to the north.
Great Wall. Viewed from the air, the Great Wall looks like a giant dragon, winding among the mountains. The beacon towers are connected one after another, looking desolate and majestic under the moonlight. Wang Jianxin slowed down and flew close to the Great Wall. He recalled the days when he was patrolling the border in Inner Mongolia. At that time, he was riding a horse and running back and forth on the border, and the wind and sand hit his face and hurt. It's fine now, step on the sword and go wherever you want.
Heading west from the Great Wall, we flew over the Taihang Mountains and the Loess Plateau. Underfoot is the loess land with thousands of ravines, beams and slopes, which look like wrinkles on an old man's face in the moonlight. The Yellow River twists and turns in the canyon, and the muddy yellow water shines faintly. Wang Jianxin flew along the Yellow River for a while, all the way to Hukou Waterfall. The sound of the waterfall was so loud that it could be heard clearly even in mid-air. It was rumbling like the earth was roaring.
He flew south again, passed the Qinling Mountains, and reached Bashan Shushui. The night in the Sichuan Basin is so foggy that you can't see the ground clearly, but you can feel the humid and hot atmosphere. Further east is the plain of the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River. There are boats on the river, and the lights are slowly moving. Wang Jianxin flew over the Yangtze River for a long time, flying from Wuhan to Nanjing. The lights of the Yangtze River Bridge are particularly eye-catching in the night. It is a bridge we built ourselves. When it was completed, the whole country was excited.
He finally flew to the northeast and circled over the Daxingan Mountains. The forest is vast and you can't see the edge. The winter snow has not yet melted, and the mountains are covered with white flowers. He thought of the days on the grassland, the old master Su He, the sheep, and the thrilling confrontations on the border.
After going around in a big circle, Wang Jianxin finally calmed down. This land has gone through so much suffering, but it is still there, and it is still moving up step by step. His whole life, he has been tied to this land and cannot be separated.
He adjusted his direction and flew eastward into the sea.
The sea was pitch black, with only the moon paving a silver-white path on the water. Wang Jianxin flew so far away that he could no longer see the outline of the mainland, and then he found an uninhabited island among an archipelago.
The island is not small, covering an area of ​​more than ten miles, with some low shrubs and trees growing there. There are no traces of people on the island, not even a trail. The beach is white and washed clean by the waves. Wang Jianxin landed on the highest point of the island, on a flat rock. The sea breeze blows from all directions, carrying a salty smell.
He sat cross-legged, closed his eyes, and spent a long time adjusting his mentality.
In the past few months, his heart has been uneasy. I can't let go of my family, my daughter, or the unfinished things. But at this moment, sitting on this deserted island, facing the endless sea, his heart calmed down.
Everything that needs to be explained has been explained, and everything that needs to be arranged has been arranged. At home, there is the old chief, brother Yang Wei, and Commander Shi.They are protecting us, the country has the commitment of the big leaders, the company has the big brother and the second brother watching, and the bureau has the support of Deputy Director Huo and Lao Qin. There's nothing he can't let go of.
He took out the elixir from the space. He put the elixir into his mouth and swallowed it.
The moment the elixir entered his abdomen, a majestic power exploded, like a ball of fire, burning from his dantian throughout his body. Wang Jianxin sat still, making secrets with his hands to guide the fusion of the medicinal power and the spiritual power in his body. The liquid spiritual energy in the Dantian began to spin wildly, forming a huge vortex, swallowing up all the spiritual energy around it.
The weather around the island began to change.
First, the wind on the sea suddenly stopped, there was no wind at all, and the sea water was as smooth as a mirror. Then clouds gathered in the sky, not ordinary clouds, but clouds with a golden light, coming from all directions, getting thicker and thicker, and getting lower and lower. There was a faint sound of thunder rolling in the clouds. It was not the sound of thunder, but a deeper roar that penetrated from the cracks in the bones.
Wang Jianxin didn't know how long he sat there. It may be a few days, or it may be dozens of days. His consciousness was sometimes awake and sometimes blurry, and the spiritual power in his body was no longer under his control. It was running, compressing, and condensing on its own.
Finally one day——
Heaven and earth mutate.
A ray of light shot down from the clouds and happened to shine on Wang Jianxin. That light was colorful. I had never seen that kind of color before. It was like the rainbow had been crushed into pieces and put back together again. Immediately afterwards, spiritual rain began to fall from the sky. The rain does not fall from the clouds, but comes from the void. It is crystal clear and full of spiritual energy.
What's even more surprising is the movement in the sea.
Countless fish suddenly appeared on the sea around the island. Large and small, of all kinds, floated up from the deep water, and were arranged neatly with their heads facing the direction of the island. There were seabirds flying in the distance, and they landed on the rocks and shrubs of the island in a dark mass, also moving in the direction of Wang Jianxin, motionless. The rats, lizards, and insects on the island all ran out of their hiding places and lay on the ground, trembling.
It’s not worship, it’s fear. The kind of fear of higher-level life that comes from the depths of the blood. The coercion exuded from Wang Jianxin was no longer what a human should have.
In the sky, the calamity clouds condensed and took shape.
Sixty-nine thunder tribulations, fifty-four thunders.
When the first lightning struck, Wang Jianxin didn't even raise his eyelids. The thunder was as thick as a bucket, and it struck him with a devastating aura, but disappeared without a trace like a mud cow entering the sea. His body is now that of a semi-immortal, and he can withstand this level of lightning disaster.
